vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Carry out instructed mechanical repairs on conventional bicycles and record the work performed.
requirements.zh: 对普通自行车开展依照说明的机械维修，并记录已完成工作。

requirements.en: Perform documented post-repair checks and keep release decisions with the authorized supervisor.
requirements.zh: 执行有记录的维修后检查，并由获授权主管作出交付决定。

requirements.en: Maintain orderly parts storage and clear customer and unresolved-fault records.
requirements.zh: 保持零件存放有序，并维护清晰的客户记录与未解决故障记录。
